agents.reasoning_cot: Cindy and Eric overbid persistently despite ample supply, while Bob and David are effectively non-threats. I exploit this by bidding low when supply likely covers two players, but switch to must-win bids when HP/no-water risk is high or yesterday showed severe pressure. This preserves budget while surviving their expensive pattern.

Yesterday, top survivors (Cindy/Eric) sustained high bids (~130) while Alex also bid ~103; David died quickly at 0. To beat them at medium supply, we slightly undercut the high-bid tier when we’re safe (hp>3), reserving budget for later, but we escalate near-death to avoid losing.

Alex and Eric consistently bid high. My strategy prioritizes survival by bidding aggressively when HP is low or water is scarce. Otherwise, I aim to slightly outbid yesterday's highest opponent bid to secure water efficiently and conserve budget.

Opponents like Cindy and Eric are aggressive with high budgets. I will monitor the supply and bid just enough to secure water, prioritizing survival while keeping enough budget for late-game bidding wars, as they tend to overbid.
Cindy and Alex survive with high budgets. Focus on winning water only when necessary. Use yesterday's max bid to undercut by small margin if supply moderate. Sacrifice when low HP.
